text: To be unable to bear privation for a short time is disgraceful cowardice, not true valour. Those who voluntarily offer themselves to death are more easily found than those who would calmly endure distress.
author: Julius Caesar
speaker: Critognatus
reference: Commentaries on the Gallic and Civil Wars
translation: W. A. McDevitte and W. S. Bohn, 1869
